functions.name: analyze_jurisdiction
functions.description: Analyzes intersection data based on administrative jurisdiction (District Office/구청 or Police Station/경찰서). Supports COUNT, LIST, and COMPARE modes.

action_type.description: Whether to just count the intersections, list their names, or compare two areas.

functions.name: analyze_signal_timing
functions.description: Analyzes traffic signal attributes such as cycle length, yellow time, all-red time, pedestrian signals, and phase configurations.

threshold_value.description: Value to filter by if condition is threshold (e.g., 140 for 140s cycle)

functions.name: analyze_civil_complaints
functions.description: Mines civil complaint (민원) data from the Yearbook database based on keywords, dates, and locations.

timeframe.description: Specific year or month to filter

functions.name: analyze_safety_zones
functions.description: Filters intersections based on safety zone designations (School, Elderly, Disabled) and speed limits.

speed_limit_filter.description: True if filtering by speed limits is required

functions.name: analyze_network_group
functions.description: Analyzes intersection coordination groups, independent nodes, and network consistency.

group_name.description: Specific name of the coordination group

audit_mode.description: True to run consistency checks (e.g., cycle mismatch)

functions.name: map_highlight
functions.description: Visualizes a list of intersections on the dashboard map.
